text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each of them gave it everything they had. 
As a result— Admire Vega claimed the 
victory. Her razor-sharp run was 
reminiscent of her former self.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the four of them express 
how fulfilling it was to give it their 
all. Inspired by this, Narita Top Road 
suggests they all run together again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, T.M. Opera O was evasive about 
the proposal. She seemed to have something 
in mind, but left only with the promise 
that they would speak again another day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad I got to spend time with those 
three—" Having said that, what kind of 
finish line will she reach together with 
everyone in her next race, the Arima 
Kinen?
